title: Exclusive: Viz Hosts Signing Tour for GalaXic Baseball League Comic Artist Acky Bright
content: Viz Media announced on Wednesday a signing tour across the United States for the GalaXic Baseball League comic series — Viz's collaboration with MLB Players, Inc., OneTeam Partners, and the BW NYC Studios of Japanese artist Acky Bright. The tour will start on October 13, the release date of the comic's first volume.
author: ANN

title: Walking Home with You Anime Unveils April 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Mai Matsuda 's Walking Home with You ( Hōkago Kitaku Biyori ) manga opened on Wednesday and confirmed the anime's television format. The website also unveiled the anime's teaser visual and April 2027 premiere on the NTV channel.
author: ANN

title: Code Geass: Lost Stories Game to End Service on December 7
content: The official website for the Code Geass : Lost Stories social game announced on Wednesday that the game will end service on December 7. Sales of the in-game Sakuradite currency, Lost Stories Pass, and Starter Pack has also ended on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint Returns as Cygames and Breeders’ Cup Renew Partnership
content: Cygames, Inc. has renewed its partnership with the Breeders’ Cup for the third consecutive year. Under the agreement, the weekend’s sprint race will be named the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime's 1st Video Reveals Cast, More Staff
content: The official website for the television anime of Kuzushiro 's The Moon on a Rainy Night ( Amayo no Tsuki ) manga began streaming the anime's first full promotional video on Wednesday. The video announces the anime's main cast members, as well as more staff members.
author: ANN

title: Babanba Banban Vampire Manga Listed to Enter 'Final Stage'
content: Dark Horse Comics licensed the manga, and will release the first volume in English on November 10. Dark Horse describes the manga: An unassuming worker in a long-established public bathhouse is really the lustful 450-year-old vampire Ranmaru Mori!
author: ANN

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Announced
content: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4: Founder of the Royal Academy’s So-Called Library Committee is officially getting an anime adaptation. The series’ official website announced the adaptation and confirmed that WIT Studio will continue the animation production.
author: Anime Corner

title: You Are a Four Leaf Clover Romantic Suspense Manga to End in 12th Volume
content: Retailers are listing the 12th compiled book volume of Koushi 's You Are a Four Leaf Clover ( Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ) manga as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 8. The romantic suspense manga centers around Uichi, a once popular student who is now relentlessly bullied in high school.
author: ANN

title: 'Amayo no Tsuki' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, First Promo, 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kuzushiro 's Amayo no Tsuki ( The Moon on a Rainy Night ) manga revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Reveals First Trailer, Main Cast
content: The previously announced The Moon on a Rainy Night anime revealed its first trailer along with the main cast on Wednesday.
